hypothesis: A balanced completion LoRA may improve unseen phrase and subject-verb completion over base, an explicit prompt, and an equal-delta-norm random adapter.
data: completion-v3 seed 42 development split only; candidate trained only on the v3 train split.
protocol_note: This comparison was not preregistered before generations. It is exploratory and cannot be treated as independent confirmation.
metrics: paired family bootstrap by task type
confirmation_rule: Do not consume confirmation unless the frozen candidate shows a meaningful development advantage over prompt and random controls, including separate phrase and sentence analysis, and a written preregistration is checked in first.
